form.jobPanelText: This form is for companies. Job applications go through our open positions or by sending your CV, where our recruitment team will reply.

careers.whyTitle: Projects that count on your CV. People you can count on.
careers.cvTitle: Didn’t find the right role? Leave us your CV.
careers.cvDrop: Drop your CV or LinkedIn profile

steps.title: Application
steps.text: Send your CV or LinkedIn. A person reads it, not an automated filter.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.text: We talk about what you are looking for: stack, project, model and salary.

steps.title: Technical interview
steps.text: With engineers in your field, then with the client. We give feedback at every stage.

steps.title: Offer
steps.text: A clear offer, with the contract type and conditions in writing. [Average timeline to be confirmed.]

jobs.emptyText: Leave your CV and we’ll let you know when a matching project comes up.
jobs.cvOrLinkedin: Attach your CV or add your LinkedIn profile.
jobs.cvInvalid: Your CV must be a PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB.
